admissibility_gates: all 12 pairs are present and unique
exactly six or-both and six not-both Ainglish cells
no English or Ainglish sentence duplicates any previously served token manifest for this construct

every per-pair count and both polarity means are reported even if adverse

manifest.comparison_note: This deterministic recertification measures token cost against complete disambiguated English only. It does not measure or imply comprehension, adoption, or tag fidelity.
manifest.item_selection_rule: Six inclusive and six exclusive cells authored and frozen before tokenization, spanning geography, reports, sensors, invitations, archives, schedules, deployments, voting, boot slots, shipping, billing, and locks. No exact English or Ainglish sentence occurs in any of the seven previously served token manifests for this construct.
manifest.method: For each registered tokenizer and each frozen pair, count the complete UTF-8 sentence with the tokenizer's ordinary encode method and no special tokens. Per-pair delta is tokens(ainglish) minus tokens(english). Report each tokenizer mean, inclusive and exclusive stratum means, the balanced grand mean across all 24 tokenizer-item cells, and the full per-pair counts. The filed scalar is the least-favourable tokenizer mean, with value_lo/value_hi equal to the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. No comprehension inference is permitted.
